summary: Colombia's Foreign Ministry publishes a list of the nationalities it requires to hold a visa for short visits; the US, Canada and Germany, for example, are marked as not needing one. Migración Colombia says the entry and stay permit (PIP) it grants at the border for tourism is valid for up to 90 days, and that an extension may not take the stay beyond 180 calendar days in the same calendar year. Nationalities that need a visa apply for it entirely online. Migración Colombia's free Check-Mig pre-registration is optional and speeds up the immigration interview.

faq.question: Do US citizens need a visa for Colombia?
faq.answer: No. Colombia's Foreign Ministry list marks the United States as not required to hold a visa for short visits. Migración Colombia's tourism permit is valid for up to 90 days, and an extension may not take the stay beyond 180 calendar days in the same calendar year. The free Check-Mig pre-registration is optional.

faq.question: What is Check-Mig and is it really free?
faq.answer: Check-Mig is Migración Colombia's free, optional online service that lets travellers entering or leaving Colombia pre-load their trip details from 72 hours up to one hour before travel, which substantially speeds up the interview with the immigration officer. Migración Colombia says the service is completely free.

faq.question: How can I stay in Colombia longer than 90 days?
faq.answer: Migración Colombia says the request for a Permiso Temporal de Permanencia (PTP) extension must be made 5 business days before the entry permit (PIP) expires, through its online form; a tourism permit can be extended by up to 90 calendar days, and the stay may not exceed 180 calendar days in the same calendar year.

faq.question: Do I need a yellow fever vaccination for Colombia?
faq.answer: The UK Foreign Office says you must have a yellow fever vaccination certificate to enter Colombia if you are arriving from certain countries with a transmission risk, and that you may also be asked to show it if you are travelling to areas of Colombia considered high risk.

faq.question: Do Indian or Chinese citizens need a visa for Colombia?
faq.answer: Colombia's Foreign Ministry list says Colombia requires Indian and Chinese nationals to hold a visa for short visits, but exempts those who hold a US or Schengen visa valid for more than 180 days on the day they enter Colombia. Others apply for a visa, entirely online.

levies.impuesto-turismo.text: El hecho generador del impuesto con destino al turismo es la compra de tiquetes aéreos de pasajeros, en transporte aéreo de tráfico internacional, cuyo viaje incluya el territorio colombiano y su origen sea el exterior.

Son sujetos pasivos del impuesto con destino al turismo, todos los pasajeros cuyo tiquete de viaje incluya a Colombia, en medios de transporte aéreo de tráfico internacional. No serán sujetos pasivos del impuesto los pasajeros que vengan al territorio colombiano en tránsito o en conexión internacional.

El impuesto con destino al turismo tendrá un valor de USD15 y deberá ser incluido por las empresas que presten de manera regular el servicio de transporte aéreo internacional de pasajeros, en el valor de los tiquetes o pasajes aéreos.
